Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]

Core:

  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url

  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element

  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab

  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly 2D park game inspired by the provided concept art, with a small “take photos and unwind” objective and responsive touch/keyboard controls.

## Requirements
- Create a complete playable game for phone/tablet screens, with touch controls and responsive layout.
- Keep the experience simple, polished, and runnable in the browser without clarifying questions.
- Assume a reasonable interpretation of the brief and finish the implementation.

## Decisions
- Built a lightweight single-page canvas game instead of a larger engine so it runs quickly in a browser and remains mobile-friendly.
- Chose a simple “wander + collect 3 photo spots + reach the sign” loop to match the provided “Quit right now” theme and make the game finishable.
- Added keyboard support alongside touch controls to keep the game playable on desktop and mobile.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented a full game page in `index.html` with HUD, intro overlay, ending overlay, and touch controls.
- Implemented gameplay logic in `game.js` including movement, jumping, photo spot collection, win condition, sound toggle, and responsive resizing.
- Added a `favicon.svg` and corrected the browser asset issue.
- Started a local HTTP server and verified the game loads in a browser via Playwright.
- Captured a current screenshot at `screenshots/latest.jpg`.

- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open the game in the browser and verify final playfeel on mobile-sized viewport.
2. If needed, tune movement, photo detection, or layout based on actual rendered behavior.
3. Keep the project ready for further iteration or handoff.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: main game layout, overlays, HUD, touch controls, and styling
- `game.js`: gameplay logic, rendering, controls, win/lose flow, and photo collection
- `favicon.svg`: browser tab icon
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: latest browser screenshot captured for check

## Important Context
- The game is a browser-based HTML canvas experience served locally at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The current build supports both keyboard and touch controls and is set up for phone/tablet play.
